title: Event ledger decomposition
description: Objective: split the event ledger by transaction, append, outbox, and recovery responsibility. Deliverable: focused internal modules preserving atomic order and recovery behavior. NOT in scope: new event schemas or relay behavior. Hard dependencies: none. Owned paths: packages/store/src/event-ledger.ts, new event-ledger-*.ts, and store core/recovery tests. Verification: pnpm --filter @moe/store typecheck && pnpm --filter @moe/store test.
definitionOfDone: Event, aggregate sequence, global cursor, and outbox order remain unchanged.
Crash and commit-ambiguity cases preserve all-or-none acknowledged behavior.
Every resulting production module is under 350 lines.
The focused store typecheck and test command exits 0.
taskRails: Refactor-only tasks preserve public contracts and stable errors.
Do not weaken or rewrite tests to make the split pass.
Stage only explicit owned paths; no worktree, broad add, push, or merge.
